description: Retrieve coarse NASA POWER model-derived daily UTC mean temperature and precipitation for provided coordinates and historical date. Sends the coordinates and date to NASA. Results are not street-level observations, do not identify snowfall, snow cover, conditions at a specific hour, or prove whether a video matches. Dates may be delayed or unavailable. Review evidence against local observations and the brief. Free and rate-limited.
name: get_historical_weather_evidence
title: Get historical weather evidence for a location and date
